about.whoWeAreText:
BIM SOLUTIONS PARTNER & TECHNICAL LEAD.

    Cosmos.Lab Studio is a next-generation BIM partner redefining traditional architectural production through algorithmic processes. We bridge the gap between architectural intent and engineering reality.
    For us, an architectural project is not just lines; it is a massive database that must be managed. By combining Computational Design with ISO 19650 standards, we produce clash-free, fabrication-ready (LOD 400) models, basing data accuracy on algorithmic control rather than just human effort.
about.teamDescription: Led by two managing partners, Cosmos.Lab operates with an agile team structure scalable to project needs.
about.whatWeDoText:
ARCHITECTURAL SOLUTION & DIGITAL CONSTRUCTION PARTNERSHIP.

    We delegate repetitive manual tasks to autonomous systems. In large-scale and complex projects where traditional methods fall short; we consolidate design, documentation, interdisciplinary coordination, and BIM processes under a single roof.
    Thanks to our custom-developed automation systems, we operate as a technical partner that transfers design decisions to the construction site flawlessly, without risking the project's budget and schedule targets.

automation_info.title: TECHNOLOGICAL CAPACITY
automation_info.description:
We manage your projects with the latest digital infrastructure. When necessary, we create seamless, real-time collaboration environments for global teams through Revit Server deployments.
    We process data, not just geometry: Through custom-built scripts, we transform 2D drawings into intelligent 3D BIM models; extracting quantity take-offs (QTO), material schedules, and room data lists with 100% accuracy, free from human error. We minimize project delivery times by managing thousands of sheets of documentation through automation.
